<p align="center"><strong>Star lantern assembled. Find its bearing upstairs.</strong></p>

<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key &middot; Moonseed &middot; Copper coil &middot; Star lantern &middot; Black cat companion</small></p>


<p align="center">A thin star of light appears in the glass. The frame warms in your hands. Against all reasonable expectations, it works.</p>

<p align="center">The moonseed and coil are secured inside; you carry them as part of the assembled lantern.</p>

<p align="center">A narrow spiral stair climbs to the observatory. The beacon needs a direction before it can guide anyone.</p>
